items.text:
Bloomfield County posted its updated property-tax calendar this week. The second installment is due August 31, and the assessor's office notes that mailed payments must be postmarked by that date. Online payments close at 11:59 p.m. local time. A short FAQ addresses the most common questions, including what to do if you recently moved within the county.

The county has also expanded its automated phone assistant, which can read back your balance and confirm whether a payment has posted. Staff emphasize that the assistant cannot change a due date or waive a penalty, and that any disputed amount still needs a written request. Call volumes usually peak in the final three days, so the office suggests calling early in the week.

If you believe your assessment is incorrect, the appeal window runs through September 15. Forms and instructions are available at the counter and on the county site. Questions can go to the assessor's office at 555-0142.
